Mikkos, Rhea's little brother, is also a victim of the cursed urns. Oracle Cyra says the urns' creator can only be found by investigating the source of the ceremony—the Naos of Fate, an ancient reliquary of fates.

Oracle Cyra will join me at the Naos to hunt for the creator of this curse.
Travel to the Naos of Fate
Mikkos, Rhea's little brother, is also a victim of the cursed urns. I should speak with Oracle Cyra to see if she knows how we can find the source of this curse.
The brighter the light, the darker the shadow.

Mikkos, Rhea's little brother, is also a victim of the cursed urns. Oracle Cyra says the urns' creator can only be found by investigating the source of the ceremony—the Naos of Fate, an ancient reliquary of fates.

Oracle Cyra will join me at the Naos to hunt for the creator of this curse.

Melania ran off into the Naos of Fate to find the eternal brazier—hoping its ever-glowing flame can help her avoid the fate depicted on her urn. Petros has given chase.

Oracle Cyra says there is no hiding from the curse. We must find its source if there is any hope for the youths' survival.
